revisions.change_summary: Description of change: EDMS transition (FileHold to Silq eQMS definition); added QMSR Supplementary Provision Mapping section (section 820.10(b) requirements to implementing procedures); added Medical Device File section (ISO 13485 clause 4.2.3 construct mapping DMR, DHF, DHR, risk management file, labeling, and product specifications); updated generic 21 CFR Part 820 citation to QMSR; corrected internal SOP cross-reference error. Reason for change: DC.SLQ002 EDMS transition; 2026 Quality Plan (QMSR Supplementary Provision Mapping; Medical Device File Framework); IA-2025 OFI 8.
